extensionDescription.message: Tingkatkan volum sehingga 600% dengan limiter, penyama dan imbangan saluran. Setiap tab dan sumber terbuka.

optionsLead.message: These settings apply to every new tab. Per-tab volume is controlled from the toolbar popup.

optionsStartingVolumeHint.message: Applied to tabs that have no saved settings of their own.

optionsMaxVolumeHint.message: Raising this ceiling can damage speakers and hearing. Keep the limiter on.

optionsForgetSettingHint.message: Recommended. Every tab starts from the default volume.

optionsRememberSettingHint.message: Revisiting the site restores the volume you last used there.

optionsAutoLimiterHint.message: Prevents clipping and sudden loud peaks when boosting.

optionsTabCaptureHint.message: Chromium only. Lets the extension boost pages whose audio cannot be read directly, at the cost of a recording indicator on the tab.

optionsLanguageHint.message: The name shown in your browser's own add-on list always follows the browser's language, not this setting.

optionsSavedSitesHint.message: Editing a site here applies immediately to any tab already open on it.

optionsConfirmClearAll.message: Forget the saved volume for every site?

optionsConfirmRestore.message: Restore all settings to their defaults?

optionsEqSaved.message: Equalizer settings are saved for this site.

optionsEqNone.message: No equalizer settings saved for this site.

popupGainHint.message: Melebihi 100% pembatas kekal hidup untuk mengelakkan herotan.
